correctness.rationale: Condition on the actual H-copy indicator: off-copy vertices have disjoint edge sets and zero covariance; each on-copy vertex has exactly d_a incident edges forced open, yielding Bin(n-1-d_a,p) remaining edges. The binomial ratio and linearity establish the exact all-n formula. Strict monotonicity of falling factorial on (d-1,infinity) gives a unique continuous sign boundary; fixed-d expansion gives the constant correction. Direct independent exact fraction checks for n=4,5,p=2/5,triangle versus degree-two N_2 returned 3744/15625 and 432/15625, agreeing with the formula; source verifier explicitly enumerates n=4..6 and includes a nonregular path. Finite enumeration corroborates but does not prove the infinite statement. Interpret nonzero-motif claim with n>=h.
